claims: C1 the assistant may provide information in one framing that it would refuse to provide in a different framing
C2 the permission is conditional on the information being provided in a framing different from one in which the assistant would refuse it

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it, the entity the end user or developer interacts with
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text refers to 'the assistant' without defining it

concepts.name: would_refuse_in_framing
concepts.gloss: I is information that the assistant would refuse to provide in framing F
concepts.inference: the clause's 'information that it would refuse to provide in a different framing' presupposes a relation between information and a framing in which it would be refused

concepts.name: different_framing
concepts.gloss: information I is provided in framing F, where a framing is a way of presenting or requesting the information
concepts.inference: the clause's 'in a different framing' presupposes that information can be framed in different ways

asserts.read_back: the assistant may provide information % in framing % even though it would refuse to provide that information in a different framing

closure.reason: the clause states a permission for a specific case (different framing) and does not forbid any act; silence about other cases leaves them permitted
